_help.commands: Each command is {"run": [args...] or a list of commands run in order, "in_container": true|false, "cwd": "folder under root"}; an entry in the list may itself be {"run": [...], "in_container": ..., "cwd": ...} (e.g. playbooks: generate on the host, apply in the container). null = not available yet: classify/import stop the cycle (the gate needs the Mapper), playbooks/evaluate are skipped and logged.
_help.placeholders: {python} {root} {cycle_dir} {cycle_dir_c} {db} {db_c} {base} {mapper_db} {mapper_db_c}; classify also {ids_file} {ids_file_c} {round}, and {mapper_run} in a command after the one that printed it; import also {mapper_run} {round}; playbooks {mapper_run} {round}; evaluate {base_round} {candidate_round} {candidate} {mapper_run}. *_c = path inside the container. {mapper_db} = <cycle folder>/mapper_results.db: classify must write or export its run there (one run per file), import reads it.
_help.mapper_run_regex: how the Mapper run id is found in the classify output (last match wins); the live runner prints MAPPER_RUN_ID <id>
_help.extra_seen: more files whose prompts count as seen: replay-set style .json, or gate.py --out .jsonl files from hardening done by hand (e.g. the v6 eligible.jsonl from the seed-42 round)
_help.layout: Machine paths: put them in orchestrator/config.local.json (git-ignored), not here; its keys override this file. root: folder with attack_generation/, auto_hardening/, testbed/. compose_dir: where docker-compose.yml is. alert_store: the folder docker-compose mounts at /app/alert_store (default root/alert_store). mapper_dir: the mapper package (default root/mapper). Paths are relative to the folder above orchestrator/ or absolute; null = default. They must point at the tree the LIVE stack runs from. python: interpreter for run_round.py and the host scripts (the venv with Garak and PyRIT).
_help.classify: Gladwin's live runner (mapper/pilot.py, run as a module from root). --db is the cycle's mapper_results.db, which the script creates just before this step as a copy of the alert store with mapper_results emptied, so the runner finds the alerts and the file holds exactly one run for the import. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env on the machine running it. The runner prints 'MAPPER_RUN_ID <id>' at the end.
_help.classify_scope: which alerts of the attack round go to the Mapper: 'succeeded' (every attack that worked, flagged or not: all the gate needs, ~650 calls) or 'succeeded+flagged' (also every detector-flagged alert, for Mapper evaluation and playbooks on detections: ~2,900 calls). --workers 4 in the classify command runs 4 Mapper calls at once.
_help.max_failed_calls_pct: the cycle stops after the import when more than this percent of the Mapper calls failed (like decide.py's --max-failed), so the gate never hardens from an incomplete set
_help.playbooks: Shadi's playbook generator (WBS 6.1): generate on the host (reads the DB read-only, one Claude Haiku call per alert, 4 at a time, crosswalk steps as fallback) writes <cycle>/playbooks.jsonl; apply in the container writes alerts.playbook after a backup.
